_comment: Demon pad: 2.5 m dia x 0.15 m boost disc, origin at base centre, sigil points +Y in Blender = -Z in Godot. One textured material (128x128 atlas, sigil quarter emissive), one UV set. DemonPadCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` thin 8-sided cylinder; its mesh is discarded on import so surfaces stays 1.
